clips.title: The story
paras: In the Wetlands, Prospector Whelgar finds a relic marked by the keepers. He sends you with it to Ironforge, where the Explorers' League can study the titans' legacy.

Prospector Whelgar finds a remarkable artifact while surveying the Wetlands. Intricate keeper inscriptions cover its many facets, and Whelgar authenticates the titan-like markings. He urges you to carry the relic to Ironforge, where scholars can study it. Whelgar hopes the discovery will enter the official catalogue, with both your recovery and his authentication properly credited.

High Explorer Magellas receives the relic for the Explorers' League in Ironforge's Hall of Explorers. Its maker marks confirm its authenticity. Magellas says the light passing through its polished facets recalls wonders he saw on his first excavation in Uldaman. Your donation preserves the artifact for study and adds to the League's records of the titans' legacy.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: With titan-like inscriptions like that on its facets, nothing less than Ironforge's Hall of Explorers is the right place to bring it.
I'd like to think that you'll be noted in the history for it in the catalogue -- "Recovered by friend! Authenticated by Prospector Whelgar..." Ah, I'm gettin' meself carried away.
High Explorer Magellas will receive you, and given the exquisite nature of what you carry, will surely be most generously appreciative should you donate it to the museum.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have a look at our gallery, but please, don't touch the artifacts, unless it's one you're here to donate to the library.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Woah! Look at this marvel! The light through it dances like nothin' I've seen since my first dig in old Uldaman. The marks of the keepers on this cannot be mistaken.
You've done the League a great service bringin' this home. A find like this pushes the very boundaries o' the world's wisdom forward.
We'll be sure to record the details of your contribution! Truly a job well done, adventurer.
